body_markdown: `AE-19` gives the requested standalone simple-seed lift with $\Delta\le D<p$. Formal implicit uniqueness identifies the degree-$d$ truncation with every supplied line label; then $C(X,Y,Q)$ has degree at most $\Delta$ and more than $\Delta$ distinct line factors, so irreducibility gives $C\sim Z-Q$. The simple seed remains essential by `AE-11`.
subject: Characteristic-safe simple-pencil lift
